nameOrigin: Japanese name for a pet salamander/axolotl

pokedexEntries.go: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

pokedexEntries.si: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

pokedexEntries.cr: A mucous membrane covers its body. Touching it barehanded will cause a shooting pain.

pokedexEntries.rs: WOOPER usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.

pokedexEntries.fr: When it walks around on the ground, it coats its body with a slimy, poisonous film.

pokedexEntries.lg: This POKéMON lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

pokedexEntries.em: WOOPER usually live in water but come out onto land seeking food occasionally. On land, they coat their bodies with a gooey, toxic film.

pokedexEntries.di: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.

pokedexEntries.prl: When the temperature cools in the evening, they emerge from water to seek food along the shore.

pokedexEntries.pt: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
